description: couchbase-cli-setting-rebalance.md's OPTIONS defines --max-attempts <num> for the maximum retry count; its EXAMPLES section instead shows '--retries 2' in the enable-retry example, a flag never defined anywhere on the page (confirmed: SYNOPSIS/OPTIONS list only --set/--get/--cancel/--pending-info/--enable/--wait-for/--moves-per-node/--max-attempts/--rebalance-id, no --retries). Separately, the EXAMPLES text 'To cancel a pending rebalance retry run the command below' is followed by a command using --pending-info --rebalance-id, not --cancel - the example shown retrieves pending-retry info rather than cancelling it, despite the surrounding prose describing a cancel operation.
